sql.if: AND (ss.region_id = #{regionId} OR ss.region_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id = #{regionId}) OR ss.region_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id = #{regionId})) OR ss.region_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM region WHERE parent_id = #{regionId}))))

mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.region_id, ss.title, ss.cover, ss.content, ss.summary, ss.create_time, r2.id AS parent_region_id, CASE WHEN r1.level = 1 THEN r1.name WHEN r1.level = 2 THEN r2.name WHEN r1.level >= 3 THEN r3.name END AS county_name, CASE WHEN r1.level = 1 THEN NULL WHEN r1.level = 2 THEN r1.name WHEN r1.level >= 3 THEN r2.name END AS town_name, CASE WHEN r1.level >= 3 THEN r1.name ELSE NULL END AS village_name, ssb.id AS brochure_id, ssb.scenic_spot_id, ssb.cover_url, ssb.order_number, (SELECT COUNT(uao1.id) FROM user_action_operation uao1 WHERE uao1.type = 3 AND uao1.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT' AND uao1.content_id = ss.id) AS view_count, (SELECT COUNT(uao2.id) FROM user_action_operation uao2 WHERE uao2.type = 2 AND uao2.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT' AND uao2.content_id = ss.id) AS upvote_count, (SELECT COUNT(uao3.id) FROM user_action_operation uao3 WHERE uao3.type = 1 AND uao3.content_module = 'SCENIC_SPOT' AND uao3.content_id = ss.id) AS collection_count FROM scenic_spot ss LEFT JOIN region r1 ON r1.id = ss.region_id LEFT JOIN region r2 ON r2.id = r1.parent_id LEFT JOIN region r3 ON r3.id = r2.parent_id LEFT JOIN scenic_spot_brochure ssb ON ssb.scenic_spot_id = ss.id WHERE ss.id = #{id}
